text: If you have not taken my courses and do not understand what some “fifth chakra” has to do with this, I recommend that you combine taking this intensive with the workshop or course in which I gradually lead you to an understanding of what we are doing here. It is important not simply to “believe” me, but to open up understanding within yourself through personal experience — both on the yoga mat and in life. Then the practices begin to work much deeper. Otherwise we get physical exercise — since this is the basic understanding (experience) of yoga that everyone has.
